A different route.
My Canadian friend Alex is staying with us this week. We are visiting a castle tomorrow, and we are meeting my cousin at the tram stop. The tram leaves at eleven, so Mum says we must be there ten minutes early. I check a local map and put our tickets in my bag. In the morning, a crowd is waiting near the stop. A notice says the tram is delayed because of a problem with the track. I want to walk the whole way, but the castle is too far. Alex finds another route on the map. We can take a bus to Castle Road. Mum calls my cousin and tells her about the new plan. She is meeting us at the bus stop instead. On the bus, I put our luggage under the seat. At Castle Road, we cross at the traffic light and walk straight on. My cousin is there before us. She has our picnic lunch, so nobody has to carry food from home. Inside the castle, Alex takes pictures of the wide courtyard. I am glad our visit can still go ahead. Next time, I will check the travel notices as well as the timetable.
